data.name: Combustible Mutagen
data.description: This discovery allows you to fuel your mutagen with psionic power in order to become combustible.  Anyone striking you with a melee weapon while under the effects of this discovery takes %1d6 points fire damage.  Creatures making melee attacks from more than 5 ft. away with reach weapons do not suffer this damage.  If you die from the attack, all creatures within 10 feet of the mutator take %2d6 fire damage as your body bursts in a fiery explosion.|CombustibleMutagenDice|CombustibleMutagenExplosionDice
